nodes.label: AgroFlex Favicon
nodes.description: Same AgroFlex leaf + wordmark logo on transparent background, used as site favicon.

nodes.label: AgroFlex Messages page (conversation with Jeremie)
nodes.description: Two-pane messaging UI: conversation list (Jeremie, Tuvune, Arkip Store, 'Appel passé' call entries) and chat thread with 'Voir l'offre' link, bubbles with timestamps, 'Votre réponse' input and Envoyer button. Footer: 'AgroFlex · Les prix agricoles et les contacts, près de chez vous'.

nodes.label: AgroFlex Brand Identity (green leaf + wordmark)
nodes.rationale: Green leaf motif signals agriculture; two-tone wordmark emphasizes 'Flex'.
